title: On sparsity, extremal structure, and monotonicity properties of Wasserstein and Gromov-Wasserstein optimal transport plans
abstract: arXiv:2602.16265v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This note gives a self-contained overview of some key properties of the Gromov-Wasserstein (GW) distance, compared with the standard linear optimal transport (OT) framework. More specifically, I explore the following questions: are GW optimal transport plans sparse? under what conditions does there exist an optimal plan supported on a permutation? do optimal plans satisfy a form of cyclical monotonicity? In particular, I present the conditionally negative/positive definite (CND/CPD) properties and show that, when they hold, there exist GW optimal plans that are sparse and supported on a permutation. In the last section, I also give examples where no permutation is optimal when the CND or CPD assumption is dropped.

translated_title: 关于Wasserstein与Gromov-Wasserstein最优传输计划的稀疏性、极值结构与单调性性质
translated_abstract: 本简报对Gromov-Wasserstein（GW）距离的一些关键性质进行了自成一体的综述，并与标准的线性最优传输（OT）框架进行比较。更具体地说，我探讨了以下问题：GW最优传输计划是否稀疏？在什么条件下存在支撑于置换上的最优计划？最优计划是否满足某种形式的循环单调性？特别是，我给出了条件负定/正定（CND/CPD）性质，并证明当这些性质成立时，存在稀疏且支撑于置换上的GW最优计划。在最后一节中，我还给出了在去掉CND或CPD假设时置换并非最优的例子。
tldr: 本文系统梳理了Gromov-Wasserstein最优传输的关键性质，证明了在条件负定/正定（CND/CPD）条件下存在稀疏且支撑于置换上的最优传输计划，并给出不满足这些假设时置换并非最优的反例。
en_tdlr: This note reviews key properties of Gromov-Wasserstein optimal transport, proving that under conditionally negative/positive definite (CND/CPD) conditions there exist sparse optimal plans supported on permutations, along with counterexamples showing permutations may fail to be optimal when these assumptions are dropped.
